verdict.rationale: Decagon supports agents that operate autonomously in the background — Proactive Agents that initiate calls and recommendations based on customer signals across sessions, and Watchtower that continuously reviews every interaction against custom criteria without human triggering. This shows autonomous, non-interactive operation but the evidence frames it around customer-support use cases rather than a general-purpose automation/scheduling framework for AI-native users. Missing for 10: explicit trigger/schedule configuration, a broader automation-builder UI beyond proactive outreach and monitoring, and independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability running unattended.
